name: agent-ide
description: Claude-Code-style AI agent in your editor: parallel chats, live diffs, checkpoints, context control — and remote control from your phone & Telegram.

commands.title: Agent IDE: Export Conversation to Markdown
Agent IDE: Remote (share chat to web)
Agent IDE: Add Selection to Chat
Agent IDE: Start Local Model (hybrid engine)
Agent IDE: Stop Local Model (back to Claude)

agentIde.assistantName.description: Display name of the assistant in the chat (header + reply labels).

agentIde.autoCompact.description: Automatically compact (summarize) a chat when its context window crosses ~85%, instead of waiting for it to overflow mid-task.

agentIde.shadowGit.description: Deep checkpoints: snapshot the whole workspace into a shadow git repo at each turn start, so even files changed by terminal commands can be restored. Requires git; the first snapshot of a big repo can take a moment.

agentIde.autoResume.description: Self-healing: when a turn stalls (watchdog) or dies on a transient failure mid-stream, automatically resume the session and continue — up to 2 times per task. A manual message resets the budget.

agentIde.stallTimeoutSec.description: Watchdog: interrupt a run that has streamed nothing (no text/thinking/tools) for this many seconds. Keep generous — approval waits also look silent.

agentIde.model.description: Default model. The dropdown is populated live from the models your account supports.

agentIde.apiKey.description: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Leave empty to use the environment / claude login.

agentIde.baseUrl.description: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL override. Point at a translation proxy to use local models (LM Studio) later. Empty = Anthropic API.

agentIde.showStatusBar.description: Show the Agent IDE status-bar HUD (live state, active model, and running session cost).

agentIde.includeEditorContext.description: Master switch: auto-include editor context (active file + selection) with each message so 'fix this' needs no explanation. Toggle from the panel toolbar too.

agentIde.contextOpenTabs.description: Also include the list of open editor tabs in the auto-context.

agentIde.contextProblems.description: Also include current workspace problems (errors/warnings) in the auto-context.

agentIde.autoFixDiagnostics.description: After the agent edits files, read the editor's diagnostics for those files and automatically ask the agent to fix any errors (bounded to a few rounds).

agentIde.testCommand.description: Optional test/build command run after a clean auto-fix pass (requires autoFixDiagnostics). On failure, its output is fed back to the agent. E.g. 'npm test'.

agentIde.mcpServers.description: MCP server configs forwarded to the agent (extra tools). Same shape as the Claude Agent SDK's mcpServers option, e.g. { "playwright": { "command": "npx", "args": ["@playwright/mcp"] } }.

agentIde.relayUrl.description: Sync relay URL for remote access (the 'Agent IDE: Remote' command), e.g. ws://1.2.3.4:8790. Run relay/hub.mjs on a host you control.

agentIde.relayToken.description: Shared secret for the sync relay — this is your only auth, so make it long and private. Must match RELAY_TOKEN on the relay.

agentIde.botToken.description: Telegram bot token (from @BotFather). When set with telegramUserId, the 'Remote' command also runs a bot for folder/chat navigation + Mini App.

agentIde.telegramUserId.description: Your Telegram user id (numeric) — the bot only responds to this id (whitelist). Get it from @userinfobot.

agentIde.cloudflaredPath.description: Optional path to a cloudflared binary. Empty = auto (PATH, then download per-platform into ~/.agent-ide/bin).

agentIde.superTools.description: EXPERIMENTAL master switch: give the agent built-in extra tools. Individual modules are toggled from the panel's ⚙ settings.

agentIde.toolsEyes.description: Super tools module — Eyes: headless-browser screenshot + rendered DOM.

agentIde.toolsHands.description: Super tools module — Hands: managed dev server (start/logs/status/stop).

agentIde.toolsMemory.description: Super tools module — Memory: persistent .agent-ide/memory.md read/write.

agentIde.toolsScale.description: Super tools module — Scale: spawn read-only subagents for parallel research.

agentIde.subagentModel.description: Model for subagents/orchestrator workers. Empty = same as the main chat (recommended). They always run on your own subscription — never a separate account.

agentIde.localModelUpstream.description: Hybrid engine: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your local runtime (LM Studio default is http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; Ollama is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1).

agentIde.localModelPort.description: Hybrid engine: local port the bundled Anthropic↔OpenAI proxy listens on. agentIde.baseUrl is auto-set to http://127.0.0.1:<this> while the local model is running.

agentIde.localModelId.description: Hybrid engine: override the model id sent upstream. Empty = pass the chat's selected model id through to your local runtime.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:browser && node --test tests/e2e/browserTools.e2e.mjs tests/e2e/remote.e2e.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
